items.title: 69537_Jimmy Jones oral history interview
items.q: Norman Granz's secretary, Mary Jane Hopwater, said she thought that Duke really wanted me to do the whole album.

ctx.x: Yeah, when it was his tune.

Yeah. Yeah. So -- I forget what else I did. But I did quite a bit of writing. And it was so funny, Norman Granz's secretary, Mary Jane Hopwater, said she thought that Duke really wanted me to do the whole album. I said, "Not at the last minute. Gee whiz."
That's the only way Duke did things, at the last minute.
